name: Popover
summary: A small floating panel attached to a trigger. Holds a menu, filters or a short form.

anatomy.purpose: White square-rounded surface with a border and shadow.
Menu items, a short form or details.

variants.name: Form
variants.use: A few fields, such as filters.

whenToUse: Contextual choices near their trigger without leaving the page.
whenNotToUse: Phones with long content: use a bottom sheet.

accessibility.role: dialog or menu, opened by a button with aria-expanded
keyboard: Arrow keys move inside a menu.
accessibility.focus: Move focus inside on open; return to trigger on close.
notes: Set aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the trigger.
Close on outside click and Escape.
